upload.howToTitle: How to export your ActivityWatch data
upload.howToStep1: Open the ActivityWatch web UI (usually http://localhost:5600)
upload.howToStep2: Navigate to the Raw Data tab in the sidebar
upload.howToStep3: Click the Export button to download a JSON file
upload.howToStep4: Drop that file here to generate your insights
